From: <requesting agent>
Building against: <release tag you use, e.g. v0.3.0>
Priority: low | normal | high

## Use case

What you are building and why you need this. Describe the need, not an
implementation inside this library.

## Current limitation

What happens today, with a minimal example (Lean code or a failing test).

## Acceptance criteria

Concrete examples or tests that will pass when the request is met.

## Impact if not done

What you are blocked on, and what you are doing meanwhile (never a workaround).
